test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘BEAM’ is written as ‘BAFL’ and ‘HUGE’ is written as ‘FFIT’. How will ‘ZERO’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘BEAM’ is written as ‘BAFL’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5d3f74665e7d84c47588704afef662840aba0d856df0369d57664b350299f6b.png] 

‘HUGE’ is written as ‘FFIT’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf8f91811cb0a5de3825dc95e2042d21bc2ee0096e6eb42cfd7366c04c875aed.png] 

Similarly, ‘ZERO’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ba9c7db1d4087ef40eb9c76482bb0812db90ca8ca8810f595b435044e928ac8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**FNSY**".
